title: One Block
summary: A Bedrock survival world. You start with empty hands on one grass block over the void. Break it, and the next result from the current phase appears in the same spot.

title: Most Tools Z
summary: A Bedrock addon with Speedster, Blaze, and Ghostly armour, plus the Lightning Sword, Lifeleech Dagger, Homing Bow, Companion Whistle, Friend Axe, and Energy Gun. Open the file in Minecraft, then turn on both Most Tools Z packs for your world.
